# toml++

GTI vendors the amalgamated header from toml++ v3.4.0 under its MIT license.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus>
- Source archive: `v3.4.0.tar.gz`
- SHA-256: `8517f65938a4faae9ccf8ebb36631a38c1cadfb5efa85d9a72e15b9e97d25155`

The parser is compiled privately into `gti_driver`; toml++ types are not part
of GTI's installed driver API.
